protocol.cache: code + protocol + numerical versions + past input fingerprints; target actuals are settled separately
protocol.feature_selection: production coverage/rank/prune on training rows only
protocol.input_limit: Reconstructed vendor data; historical publication vintages are not verified.
protocol.latest_period: last 365 calendar days of resolved targets
protocol.objective: matched-origin return MAE; price RMSE reported separately
protocol.probabilities: point forecasts only; UP/FLAT/DOWN classes are not calibrated probabilities
protocol.production: chart-only research; never replaces issued forecasts or promotes a live model
protocol.purge: training origin + horizon < month start - embargo
protocol.selection_bias: Full-period winner is retrospective; candidate shortlist was informed by existing historical evaluations.
protocol.selector: lowest MAE among earlier matured OOF predictions; no-change during warm-up; baseline wins exact ties
protocol.uncertainty: 1000 moving calendar-block bootstrap samples, block = max(30,horizon); descriptive, not a promotion gate
protocol.vendor_cadence: infer update cadence from rows before each training cutoff
protocol.wide_models: existing ExtraTrees/RF/KNN parameters, training-only decay weights and causal regime overlay
